visualizations.summary: 亲手调节单比特极角 θ、方位相位 φ、环境记录重叠角 α 与退相干捏合强度 η，实时观测几何积 AB = A·B + A∧B 的内积粒子线 cos θ 与外积波动面 sin θ、记录可区分度与相干可见度的勾股圆 D² + V² = 1、SU(2)/SO(3) 旋转器门序列以及希尔伯特—施密特捏合正交分解与相对熵删除账单。
visualizations.summary_en: Interactively adjust qubit polar angle θ, azimuthal phase φ, environmental record overlap angle α, and pinching decoherence strength η to inspect the geometric product AB = A·B + A∧B, the Pythagorean complementarity circle D² + V² = 1, SU(2)/SO(3) Clifford rotor gates, and the Hilbert–Schmidt pinching decomposition and relative-entropy deletion ledger.

visualizations.title: 多面体割圆、毛球角亏与余弦不动点
visualizations.title_en: Polyhedral Approximation, Hairy Ball Defect, and Cosine Fixed Points
visualizations.summary: 亲手切换内接于球面的测地多面体（V = 12、42、60、162、642），实时数出 E = 3V − 6、F = 2V − 4 与欧拉示性数 V − E + F = 2，并对比分片欧氏等边组合模型（12 个五度顶点集中承担 12 × 60° = 720° = 4π 的曲率角亏）与实际径向投影内接多面体网格（高斯—博内/笛卡尔总度量角亏仍严格等于 4π = 720°，但同时分摊在 12 个五度顶点与六度顶点上）；调节泰勒截断项数 N 观察余项 R₂N(θ) 与拉格朗日界，调节螺距看开口螺旋投下闭合圆的影子；再从 θ₀ ∈ [0, π] 出发并排比较 Dottie 余弦蛛网 θₖ₊₁ = cos θₖ → θ* ≈ 0.739085、黄金倒数迭代 xₖ₊₁ = 1 + 1/xₖ → φ 与有限收缩集合在 N ≤ |S₀| 步内的稳定化。
visualizations.summary_en: Switch between geodesic polyhedra inscribed in the sphere (V = 12, 42, 60, 162, 642), count E = 3V − 6, F = 2V − 4 and Euler's V − E + F = 2 live, and contrast the piecewise-Euclidean equilateral combinatorial model (where the 12 degree-5 vertices carry 12 × 60° = 720° = 4π of curvature defect) with the actual radially projected inscribed polyhedral meshes (where the total metric angular defect remains strictly 4π = 720° by Gauss–Bonnet/Descartes while being distributed across both the 12 degree-5 vertices and the degree-6 vertices); vary the Taylor terms N to watch the remainder R₂N(θ) against the Lagrange bound, and the pitch to see an open helix cast a closed circle as its shadow; then, from a seed θ₀ ∈ [0, π], compare the Dottie cosine cobweb θₖ₊₁ = cos θₖ → θ* ≈ 0.739085, the golden reciprocal iteration xₖ₊₁ = 1 + 1/xₖ → φ, and a finite contracting set sequence that stabilizes within N ≤ |S₀| steps.
